title: 赵公明坐像挂件
summary: 以坐像为中心，凝练的构图呈现赵公明主题的另一种表达。
summary_en: A centered seated figure offers another expression of the Zhao Gongming motif.
body:
这款挂件采用以坐像为中心的构图，人物轮廓与下方虎纹相呼应。与细密纹饰款相比，它以更集中的视觉结构呈现传统人物主题。

图片标示赵公明，关联传统祈愿丰足的文化寓意。可作为了解道教人物图像的一件佩饰；寓意属于信仰与文化表达，不代表对财富或生活结果的保证。
body_en:
A seated figure anchors this pendant, with a tiger motif below. Its concentrated composition offers a different reading of the Zhao Gongming theme from the more densely patterned design.

The supplied photograph identifies Zhao Gongming and a traditional wish for prosperity. The pendant offers a way to explore Taoist imagery; its symbolism does not guarantee wealth or personal results.
